Supply Chain Finance Market to Reach US$ 7.35 Billion by 2035 at 13.0% CAGR; Asia-Pacific Dominates with 42.2% Share - Key Players: Citi, HSBC, Standard Chartered, DBS Bank

The global supply chain finance market reached US$ 2.16 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$ 7.35 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 13.0% during the forecast period 2026-2035. Market growth is driven by increasing demand
